items.title: Middle East: Civilian death toll climbs in Gaza, Lebanon and West Bank as UN chief demands ‘the fighting must stop’
items.description: Violence and civilian casualties are rising across the Middle East – from Israeli airstrikes in Gaza to continued hostilities in Lebanon and the West Bank – UN agencies reported on Friday as the Secretary-General declared “the fighting must stop”.

items.title: Trump announces deal for Hamas to disarm, militants demand Israel withdraws from Gaza first
items.description: President Trump announced that his Board of Peace has reached a deal with Hamas to completely disarm, calling it a "historic breakthrough." But a senior Hamas official says Israel must withdraw first.

items.title: Writing on Wall for Putin in D.C.
items.description: Timothy Ash argues that Washington’s growing bipartisan support for tougher Russia sanctions, Ukraine’s battlefield gains and drone warfare edge are shifting the dynamics of the war. He says mounting pressure could push Vladimir Putin toward negotiations as the Kremlin faces rising economic and military challenges.
